thread:
Anya: Quick heads-up: we have to compress the observability deliverables for the next quarter. Customers keep asking for per-tenant cost and faster trace correlation. Can we agree a minimal launch slice?
Devon: Reality check  can't do live heatmaps + per-token UI cost in Q2. My suggest: ship daily per-tenant aggregates + compact dashboards, then iterate for realtime.
Ravi: Agreed on the slice. For tracing we can ship an ingress span tag (tenant_id) to correlate requests without full trace collection. Sampling handles noise.
Maya: Enterprise asks: SLA breach alerts per tenant and cost attribution for chargebacks. They want near-real-time billing but can accept daily if we commit roadmap and dates.
Ben: Proposed must-have vs nice-to-have:
- Must-have: per-tenant daily cost aggregates, tenant_id in spans (pseudonymized option), sampling controls, rollout feature flag
- Nice-to-have: live heatmap, per-token breakdown UI, span waterfall viewer
Anya: Launch criteria proposal: must-have implemented + e2e acceptance tests + PRD + rollout runbook. Canary gates: error delta < 2% vs baseline, p99 latency regressions < 10%.
Devon: Implementation notes: reuse billing pipeline, add tenant_id tag during ingestion, compute daily aggregates with existing batch job. Dashboard initial filters: tenant, time-range, compare.
Ravi: Sampling config prototype (example):
```
sampling:
  default: 0.01
  enterprise_overrides:
    tenant_alpha: 0.05
    tenant_beta: 0.05
```
This keeps cost low but gives more signal for paying customers.
Maya: Security note: for tenants requiring it, tenant_id must be hashed before export. Call out retention and ACLs in PRD. Also need opt-in export controls.
Ben: Rollout plan: internal beta -> 2 enterprise partners -> GA. Use a feature flag + canary-bot to auto-halt if canary breaches thresholds.
canary-bot: Canary scheduled for week-of-2024-05-15. Monitoring hooks configured: cost_delta, error_rate, p99_latency. Alerts -> #eng-oncall + product owners.
Anya: Owners: Devon=instrumentation & acceptance tests, Maya=enterprise reqs & compliance, Ravi=sampling/runtime config.
Devon: ETA: 3 sprints for instrumentation + tests, assuming infra slot. Will open tickets and dependency list today.
Maya: I'll draft enterprise requirements doc and a compliance checklist; include pseudonymization and retention policies.
Ravi: I'll write sampling rollout config and run perf bench. Need eng-sre to reserve infra windows.
Tom (SRE): We need 48h of representative traffic for the canary and capacity headroom for bursts. Please coordinate schedule.
Anya: Decision: move forward with must-have slice. I'll synthesize a compact PRD, ticket backlog, and schedule a follow-up sync for infra windows. :thumbsup:
